text:
hana.pm: uploaded a trimmed mock — goal: make invite role-visible up front, settle SSO toggle label, and make audit filters keyboard-friendly
dave.design: role-first is clean. visual issue: invite button sits too close to role chips and reads louder than it should
mara-ux: quick fix: change CTA to ghost style + add a tiny caret. make role pill the primary control with aria-expanded so SRs see one control
lee.eng: agreed. technical ask: when SSO toggles, emit audit event type `sso_policy_change` with tenant_id, actor_id, before/after, request_id
ops-bot: note: retention automation requires tenant_id + request_id on every audit event
hana.pm: SSO label options: "SSO required" vs "Require SSO for org" — leaning to shorter label + helper. thoughts?
dave.design: label="SSO required" and helper under toggle: "All new members must sign in with your SSO provider." keeps UI compact
mara-ux: link helper via aria-describedby and announce changes in live region: "SSO requirement enabled"
lee.eng: audit nav feedback: users can't find invite events. propose horizontal filter chips with counts above list and roving tabindex for keyboard nav. we'll add GET /audit/summary?org_id=... to return counts
hana.pm: invite microcopy: change "Invite members by email" -> "Invite by email — select role before sending" and show expiry: "Invitation expires in 7 days" in confirmation
mara-ux: modal accessibility: trap focus, restore focus to CTA on close, role picker keyboard: Enter to open, Arrow to navigate, Esc to cancel
lee.eng: inline role edits should emit `role_inline_update` with before/after roles. mobile fallback opens a sheet. also add route shim so audit pages accept `view=auditable` for scrapers
dave.design: small copy tweak: use "Organization members" in modal links for clarity in nested orgs
hana.pm: I'll add acceptance criteria to PRJ-7402 and link the figma. please add API payload examples and keyboard spec as comments
ops-bot: deploy queued to staging after PR approval — summary: role-first invite, SSO label + helper, roving tabindex on audit filters, audit summary endpoint, audit event types added
